rationale: Price remains pinned at 93.5% of the daily range but has failed to exceed the 15.80 high established at entry; the last 1-minute candle printed the highest volume since entry (59k) while closing on its low and below the prior four-candle consolidation. This breaks the shrinking-selling-volume absorption that supported the long thesis, while the tape is still 8 cents above the 5-minute 9-EMA and well above the 15.68 invalidation. Closing removes exposure without committing capital to a short while the gap-up range is still intact.
